app.title: Carbon Kingdom
level1.name: Longest Chain Hunt
level1.intro: Let's find the longest carbon chain hiding in each shape, Carbie!
level1.prompt: Click through the carbons to trace the longest continuous chain.
level1.complete.title: Level 1 complete!
level1.complete.body: You've mastered the Longest Chain Hunt.
level1.chloroTaunt: Heehee, I bet you think the middle row is the longest one...
feedback.correct.2: Carbie's arms are all full — perfect!
feedback.wrong.1: So close — try counting from the other end!
feedback.wrong.2: Careful, Chloro might be hiding a longer path!
feedback.wrong.3: Not quite — Professor Methyl has a hint if you want one.
home.description: This build wires up Level 1 — {level1Name} only, for testing. Levels 2–5 and multiplayer/teacher-dashboard come next per the build plan.
result.title: Great run!

level2.name: Direction Duel
level2.intro: Pick which end to number from to get the lowest locants!
level2.prompt: Which end should you number from?
level2.complete.title: Level 2 complete!
level2.table.title: Compare locants both ways
level2.rule.bond: Rule: a double/triple bond (unsaturation) always gets the lowest locant first, even if that gives substituents higher numbers.
level2.rule.substituent: Rule: compare substituent locants in ascending order — the direction with the lower number at the first point of difference wins.
feedback2.wrong.1: So close — compare the two columns in the table again!
feedback2.wrong.2: Remember: multiple bonds always outrank substituents!
level3.name: Numbering City
level3.intro: Read the locant numbers carefully, then answer the question below!
level3.complete.title: Level 3 complete!
level3.complete.body: You read every locant perfectly — a true Mayor of Numbering City!
feedback3.wrong.1: So close — recount the numbers already labeled on the structure
feedback3.wrong.2: Remember: the numbers are already labeled for you — just read the right position
level4.name: Substituent Market
level4.intro: Tap the correct substituent cards, in alphabetical order — watch out for decoys!
level4.complete.title: Level 4 complete!
level4.complete.body: You're a true Market Master now!
feedback4.wrong.1: Not quite — check the explanation below
feedback4.wrong.2: Watch out for decoy cards and the alphabetical order!
level5.name: Boss Battle
level5.intro: This is it — put every skill together and give me the full IUPAC name!
level5.complete.title: You defeated the Boss!
level5.complete.body: You've mastered full IUPAC nomenclature — all hail the new IUPAC Master!
level5.build.prompt: Tap the name pieces in the correct order to build the full name (watch for decoys!)
level5.type.prompt: Type the full IUPAC name for this structure
feedback5.wrong.1: Not quite right — check the explanation below
feedback5.wrong.2: Double-check the direction, the bond locant, and the alphabetical order!
